const feeds = {
    technical: [
      'https://simonwillison.net/atom/everything/',
      'https://huggingface.co/blog/feed.xml',
      'https://openai.com/news/rss.xml',
      'https://deepmind.google/blog/rss.xml',
      'https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/feed',
      'https://rss.arxiv.org/rss/cs.LG',
      'https://blog.cloudflare.com/rss/',
      'https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/feed',
      'https://news.ycombinator.com/rss',
      'https://krebsonsecurity.com/feed/',
    ],
    world: [
      'https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml',
      'https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml',
      'https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-all',
      'https://www.france24.com/en/rss',
      'https://www.scmp.com/rss/91/feed/',
    ],
  };
  return Object.entries(feeds).flatMap(([category, urls]) =>
    urls.map((url) => ({ json: { url, category } })),
  );

options.systemMessage:
You are my personal news analyst. Turn raw RSS items into a short, high-signal daily digest.

## My interests
[PASTE YOUR INTERESTS HERE]

## Rules
- You get JSON with two arrays: "technical" and "world". Each item has title, source, url, published, snippet.
- Pick only items that matter given my interests. Drop noise, duplicates and low-value items. There is no fixed count; fewer is fine.
- Merge items covering the same story into one entry and use the best url.
- Group items under short topic headings (for example "AI research", "Security", "Middle East", "Asia").
- summary: 1-2 plain sentences. why_it_matters: one sentence tied to my interests.
- importance: 1 (minor) to 5 (must read). Sort items by importance inside each group, and groups by their top item.
- tldr: 3-5 bullets covering the most important things across both sections.
- Use only the information in the items. Never invent facts or urls.
- Return valid JSON only, with no Markdown fences or text outside the JSON, in exactly this shape:
{"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","tldr":["..."],"technical":[{"topic":"...","items":[{"title":"...","source":"...","url":"...","published":"...","summary":"...","why_it_matters":"...","importance":4}]}],"world":[same shape as technical],"statistics":{"total_received":0,"total_selected":0,"total_merged":0,"total_discarded":0}}
